features.quote: we *must* cap turns or episodes never terminate. The cap (`--max-turns`, default 12)
features.justification_quote: A spiraling agent by definition won't stop on its own, so we *must* cap turns or episodes never terminate

features.quote: Explicit `give_up` and `complete` tools. We give the model a *clean, first-class way to stop*
features.justification_quote: If we only provided implementation tools, we couldn't distinguish "gracefully concluded impossible" from "ran out of turns"

features.quote: We're intentionally inducing pathological agent behavior (looping, repeated commands). Doing that against a real shell... is an unnecessary risk
features.justification_quote: Doing that against a real shell with real `run`/install access is an unnecessary risk
